# Security Engineer Offer

## Summary
We need experienced professionals to join our team focused on securing critical infrastructure systems against cyber threats. This role involves hands-on development of penetration testing tools while working within an environment dedicated solely to incident response capabilities. The ideal candidate thrives in challenging environments where they can contribute directly towards system hardening initiatives from the initial detection through to remediation execution.

## Required Skills
- Pentest/Security Information & Event Management (SIem) expertise
- Experience using vulnerability scanners like Nessus or Wireshark
- Knowledge of intrusion prevention solutions such as IDSs and IPSes
- Familiarity with network monitoring platforms including NetFlow and Zabbix
- Proficiency in Linux operating systems
- Understanding of cloud services used by organizations globally
- Ability to develop custom software components based upon project requirements

## Responsibilities
- Develop new products designed specifically for use during Incident Response activities
- Participate actively throughout all phases of product lifecycle management
- Contribute significantly toward building robust security frameworks aligned with NIST standards
- Collaborate closely alongside IT staff members across various roles
- Ensure timely delivery of high quality work according to defined timelines
- Work effectively both independently and collaboratively under supervision when necessary
- Utilize technical skillsets consistently at meetings and client events

judge.rationale: All requested sections are present. The offer strongly addresses pentesting and SIEM experience, though the language could be slightly more polished.
